name: Solayer (sSOL staking, Endo)
not_assessed: the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)
the protocol's total value locked (no DefiLlama match)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The program upgrade authority is a Squads v4 multisig: 3-of-6 voters out of 6 members, with no time lock. This is an upper bound: only the program upgrade path is scored, the in-state admin, mint and config authorities are not traced.
narrative.detail: Pushed on-chain 2026-10-10 (first publication of this target). Scored 50 / 65 / 0. The program's upgrade authority is re-read on every run and must equal the offline vault PDA of the named Squads multisig. Both programs share the upgrade authority.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: program -> ProgramData FnmSeb… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly) -> Squads v4 vault 0 of multisig 5AQ3c2nC3Ua5Ms1QP4XpcfaU2Q31C8VhiUJGX3c8zFqp
independent_read.posture: admin: Squads 3-of-6 of 6 plain keys; delay: none
